verdict.rationale: MX's marketing describes an embeddable experience where consumers "ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer" (mx-docs-27), backed by personalized guidance generated from their financial data (mx-docs-14). This suggests a conversational assistant, but it is aimed at end consumers of MX's clients and is evidenced only by a single marketing line. Nothing shows an assistant inside the Client Dashboard or developer tooling that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server (mx-probe-3) is a server-side integration surface, not a built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the assistant, scope of tasks it can delegate or act on, an assistant within the Client Dashboard or developer workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
